info.name: RFIPL HRMS & Payroll API
info.description:
Postman collection for testing the RFIPL HRMS & Payroll module.

SETUP:
1. Import this file (File > Import)
2. baseUrl variable defaults to http://localhost:5000
3. Ensure sql/hrms and payroll.sql is imported and server running (npm run test)
4. WORKFLOW: Run 'Auth > Register' then 'Auth > Login' first. Login auto-saves your accessToken + refreshToken as collection variables. All other requests use Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} automatically.
